D: An escaped killer returns to his hometown to stalk babysitters on Halloween night.
P: Serve the snacks when Laurie starts babysitting Tommy.
S: Buttered salted popcorn, half coated in brown sugar caramel
Popcorn tossed in butter and salt, then caramel on half, baked at 120C for 45 minutes.
Cheddar and cream cheese ball with smoked paprika, scored like a pumpkin
Sharp cheddar, cream cheese, smoked paprika and Worcestershire shaped into a pumpkin, rolled in more paprika, a capsicum stem on top. Crackers.
trick or treat on the street in Haddonfield

Thick dark and milk chocolate cups filled with salty peanut butter fudge, set in paper cases and piled into a pumpkin bowl by the door. Melt 300g milk chocolate with 100g dark chocolate. Spoon a teaspoon into each of 16 mini paper cases and chill 10 minutes. Mix 150g smooth peanut butter with 50g icing sugar, 20g soft butter and a pinch of salt. Roll into 16 small discs and press onto the set chocolate. Cover with the remaining chocolate, sprinkle with flaky salt and chill 1 hour until firm.
M: Laurie carves the jack-o'-lantern with Tommy

Rigatoni tossed with roast pumpkin, crumbled pork sausage, crispy sage and parmesan in a garlicky brown butter sauce, chilli flakes on top. Dice 800g pumpkin, toss with oil and salt and roast at 210C for 25 minutes. Squeeze 400g pork sausages from their skins and fry in olive oil until browned and crumbly. Add 60g butter and a handful of sage leaves and cook until the butter browns and the sage crisps, then add 2 sliced garlic cloves. Boil 500g rigatoni, keeping a cup of water. Toss the pasta with the sausage, pumpkin, 60g grated parmesan and splashes of water. Finish with chilli flakes.
Beef and kidney bean chili served in hollowed small pumpkins
Beef and bean chilli simmered 90 minutes, served in small hollowed pumpkins roasted at 200C for 30 minutes, sour cream and cheddar.
W: Roasted pumpkin and mixed spice pie topped with a piped whipped cream mask
Roast pumpkin purée whisked with eggs, brown sugar, cream and spices, baked in a blind-baked case at 170C for 50 minutes, whipped cream piped as a pale mask.
K: Apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves and orange peel, no alcohol
Cloudy apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves and orange peel for 15 minutes, served hot.

s.note: Buttered salted popcorn, half coated in brown sugar caramel
s.how: Pop 120g kernels and toss with 30g melted butter and salt. Boil 100g brown sugar, 50g butter and 2 tbsp golden syrup for 4 minutes and pour over half. Bake that half at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15. Mix both together.

s.note: Cheddar and cream cheese ball with smoked paprika, scored like a pumpkin
s.how: Beat 200g grated sharp cheddar with 250g cream cheese, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp Worcestershire. Shape into a ball and chill an hour. Score lines like a pumpkin, roll in more paprika and push a capsicum stem on top. Serve with crackers.

m.note: Beef and kidney bean chili served in hollowed small pumpkins
m.how: Brown 800g beef mince with 1 onion and 2 tbsp chilli powder, add 2 tins tomatoes and 2 tins kidney beans and simmer 90 minutes. Hollow 4 small pumpkins and roast at 200C for 30 minutes. Fill with chilli, sour cream and cheddar.

w.note: Roasted pumpkin and mixed spice pie topped with a piped whipped cream mask
w.how: Roast 800g pumpkin, purée and whisk with 3 eggs, 150g brown sugar, 200ml cream and 2 tsp mixed spice. Pour into a blind-baked case of 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Cool and pipe a pale mask in whipped cream.

d.note: Apple juice simmered with cinnamon, cloves and orange peel, no alcohol
d.how: Simmer 1.5L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves and a few strips of orange peel for 15 minutes. Strain and ladle into four mugs while hot. Keep the porch light on.
